crossRefs.note: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”
Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in…
Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will…
Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am…
But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name…

translations.web: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
translations.bsb: Then He said to the disciples, “The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
